sermon.title: Rejecting Friends’ Lies 02/03/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Continuing the series on surviving tragedy, Pastor David G. Kincer shows how Job’s friends came with false accusations and doctrines: that only the guilty suffer, that God doesn’t trust His servants and that no one can be just. Satan, not God, caused Job’s losses; reject the lies but not the friends, and pray for them as Job did.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And so it was, after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, that the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is aroused against you and your two friends, for you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has. Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you. For I will accept him, lest I deal with you according to your folly; because you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has.” So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD commanded them; for the LORD had accepted Job. And the LORD restored Job’s losses when he prayed for his friends. Indeed the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

faqs.question: Is the kneeling man in the picture a friend?
faqs.answer: No, the three on the left are.

faqs.question: Are there female angels?
faqs.answer: No; angels are spirits, never referred to as women.

faqs.question: What did he say in the 70s?
faqs.answer: That Christ would not come in his lifetime.

faqs.question: What does he warn young Christians about?
faqs.answer: Thinking internet head knowledge means they know something.

faqs.question: What does Jonah’s gourd show?
faqs.answer: God can make things grow or die instantly.

faqs.question: Did Job’s friends genuinely care?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they couldn’t comfort him.

faqs.question: What can we obtain?
faqs.answer: The divine nature and its fruits.

faqs.question: Which commandments?
faqs.answer: Love one another; do no harm.
